Game Overview

In FruitBasket, the core idea is straightforward: guide your basket in the vibrant 2D world of FruitBasket, where timing and skillful catches are your allies. As fruits weave unpredictably across the sky, perfect your coordination to outscore your best. With simple, intuitive controls, this dynamic challenge is accessible and exhilarating for all.
